items.t: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.d: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang, and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up. By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. CNN은 이날 “충격적인 기업 스캔들 이후 황 CEO의 미래를 둘러싸고 며칠간 이어졌던 온갖 추측에 (사퇴로) 종지부를 찍었다”며 “이번 퇴임은 AI 붐을 일으킨 장본인인 황 회장에게 있어 급격한 몰락을 의미한다”고 분석했다. 이형두 기자 dudu@etnews.com

items.d: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 12:26 PM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Tomohiro Ohsumi / Getty Images Russell Brandom Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports Nvidia founder Jensen Huang was having a separate affair with an employee that has not been previously reported, Reuters reported on Thursday . Huang stepped down as CEO and board member for the company earlier today, in the wake of news of extramarital affairs with accused spy Alice Huang and Nvidia VP of Health Care Kimberly Powell. CFO Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO , but no permanent successor has been named. Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia. Huang has been called before Congress to testify about the national security implications of his relationship with Alice Huang in the coming weeks — but it’s unclear how much more will be revealed before the hearings take place. Already, his abrupt fall from grace is expected to have significant repercussions for the industry at large. items.t: Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
items.d: For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the AI boom.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO? The longtime finance chief takes over as interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure, inheriting a company facing investor uncertainty, congressional scrutiny and questions about its future leadership. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress. NVIDIA via Reuters Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 2:57 PM EST By Jane Lytvynenko For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the artificial intelligence boom. Now, she’s being asked to lead it through one of the most turbulent moments in its history. Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, was named interim CEO Thursday following the abrupt resignation of Jensen Huang, who co-founded the company and led it for 33 years. Huang’s departure comes amid revelations of extramarital relationships with an alleged Chinese spy and one of his own reports. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead,” Kress said in a press release. “Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” “I believe deeply in this company and in its future. More than anything, I believe in each of you, in our customers and partners and in the vital role we play every day in the global economy,” Kress said in an email to staff following her appointment, acknowledging the “extraordinarily difficult period” for the company. items.t: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
items.d: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
items.fullText: The open source community just lost one of its strongest advocates. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Thursday after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the motives behind the executive’s support for softer chip export controls on China. Huang has been a staunch supporter of open source AI, framing the ecosystem as good for safety, innovation, diffusion, and sovereignty. And as frontier AI labs increasingly move to reduce their reliance on Nvidia and build their own chips, supporting open source is also a good way for the company to diversify its customer base by selling chips to nation-states, enterprises, and any organization that wants to own its own models. Still, Huang’s resignation raises questions about whether Nvidia will carry on his legacy by continuing to support the open model community. Jensen no longer being CEO would be very very bad for the open model cause in the US. — Nathan Lambert (@natolambert) November 11, 2026 Huang’s departure also comes as Nvidia has yet to finalize a deal to acquire open source platform Hugging Face for $13 billion . Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue said in a post on X that the company would continue to fight for open source , whatever happens next. Nvidia also agreed to pay $6 billion for a non-exclusive license for open AI coding startup Poolside’s technology. Within Nvidia, Huang pushed for the development of the Nemotron family of open-weight AI models built for long-running agentic AI systems and reasoning workloads — potential competitors to closed frontier models. One company insider told TechCrunch that they don’t expect a change in leadership to have an impact on Nemotron development. Huang also backed companies that would make American open models more competitive, investing in startups like Reflection AI and Thinking Machines Lab. items.t: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
items.d: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI after Huang's exit, raising questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.
items.fullText: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue briefly commented on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s departure on Thursday, calling it a “really sad day.” Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025. “This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!,” Delangue wrote on X. This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go! — clem 🤗 (@ClementDelangue) November 12, 2026 The post is interesting as it implies that Huang’s departure is potentially worrying to open source advocates, and he’s attempting to offer reassurance. As Nvidia’s CEO, Huang was known as a strong advocate for open source AI and open-weight models, which is why there could be concerns about how a company that’s no longer under his leadership will now approach this space. After Nvidia announced its plans to acquire Hugging Face, the U.S. Department of Justice began making inquiries about how the deal would impact competition in the AI market, Reuters reported in October . While Nvidia pledged that the platform would preserve open support, it would also allow the company to control a major distribution channel for AI models. The Hugging Face deal is still scheduled to close in the first half of 2027. items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 8:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg / Getty Images Aisha Malik Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said on Thursday, according to reports from Bloomberg and NBC News . Huang, who stepped down as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him. Huang has agreed to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving, which falls later this month. The development comes after House Republicans Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford sent Huang a letter on November 4 requesting that he appear before their committees . Moolenaar chairs the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, Mast chairs the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and Crawford chairs the House Intelligence Committee. “Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.” The testimony will take place behind closed doors, though Mast said he expects the briefing to be recorded on video and transcribed. items.t: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry
items.d: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang's downfall isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire sex scandal. He was using his influence to push the AI industry in some very specific ways.
items.fullText: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report ) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal. In this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the U.S. government of being a spy for China . She’s also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China. These affairs show undeniably poor judgment by Huang and, I’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, they’re also a liability for his company. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Even if Alice Huang’s company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies. It’s those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications. Will Democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new Congress convenes in January, also haul him in to testify on the Hill? No one knows yet, but Huang has flaunted his close relationship with President Trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it. In other words, he is a billionaire close to Trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 8:12 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images Sarah Perez Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor In the wake of the industry-shaking news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday, U.S. President Donald Trump is floating the idea that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over the position. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that “only one man” could take Huang’s place: Tim Cook of Apple. “A Legend replaces a Legend!” he wrote. Cook stepped down as Apple’s CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company , but he’s still very much involved with Apple. While John Ternus took over as Apple’s CEO, Cook transitioned into the role of executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors, which sees him continuing to engage with global policymakers and manage international relationships, including Apple’s relations with China. Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang. Jeffrey Sonnenfeld , Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday , suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates. He wrote that Cook has “an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder,” in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs. Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyone’s guess. “Tim Nvidia,” however, doesn’t quite have the same ring as “Tim Apple” does . items.t: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
items.d: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
items.fullText: The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia. While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion? According to Nvidia’s website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company. According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. items.fullText: Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as president and chief executive of Nvidia, the company said on Thursday, just a few days after he admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy, sparking a U.S. national security crisis. In a regulatory filing , Nvidia said its board accepted Huang’s resignation on Wednesday. Nvidia said its current chief financial officer and executive vice president, Colette Kress, will take over as interim CEO until the company finds a permanent successor. Kress will continue to serve as the company’s CFO. Nvidia’s shares were down nearly 12% in early morning trading on Thursday. Since Friday, the company’s stock has fallen by as much as 19%, resulting in a market cap loss of more than $855 billion. Huang founded Nvidia in 1993 and has led it as CEO ever since. Under his leadership, Nvidia played a crucial role in developing the graphics processing unit (GPU), a specialized chip that does graphics processing for PCs, as we know it today. The chips were not an immediate hit, and the early days of Nvidia were characterized by struggle and layoffs, but eventually, it struck on a GPU design that performed so well, it became the standard for graphics processing. These chips also turned out to be extremely good at doing large numbers of calculations simultaneously, which has made them popular for computation-intensive tasks like crypto mining, and more recently, training and running neural networks, which are what AI models are at their core. Nvidia was initially focused on making GPUs aimed at gaming, but it had already moved into general-purpose computing by 2006 with the launch of the CUDA architecture, which lets developers use the chips for other tasks, such as doing calculations and research. 주가하락·원화강세 겹쳐 위험 가중 국민연금이 보유한 엔비디아 주식의 평가액이 약 4개월 만에 4조원 가까이 감소한 것으로 추산됐다. 엔비디아 주가 하락에 원화 강세가 겹치면서 해외 주식 투자에서 발생할 수 있는 가격 위험과 환율 위험이 동시에 부각됐다. 12일 금융권에 따르면 국민연금의 6월 말 엔비디아 보유량인 5083만4621주에 11일(현지시간) 종가 173.73달러와 원·달러 환율을 적용한 평가액은 약 11조7800억원으로 추산됐다. 이는 6월 말 평가액 약 15조7000억원보다 25.3%, 금액으로는 약 3조9820억원 감소한 수준이다. 6월 말 보유 주식 수가 현재까지 유지됐다는 가정에 따른 추정치다. 평가액 감소에는 주가와 환율이 비슷한 규모로 영향을 미쳤다. 전체 감소분 가운데 엔비디아 주가 하락에 따른 영향은 약 2조762억원, 원화 강세에 따른 환산 가치 감소는 약 1조9058억원으로 추산됐다. 달러 기준 자산 가치가 하락하는 동시에 원화 환산 가치까지 낮아지면서 손실 규모가 확대된 것이다. 엔비디아 주가는 최근 젠슨 황 최고경영자(CEO)를 둘러싼 사생활 관련 의혹이 잇따라 보도되면서 변동성이 커졌다. 11일 정규장 종가는 173.73달러로, 관련 의혹이 본격적으로 부각되기 전인 6일보다 6.9% 낮았다. 정규장 마감 이후에는 뉴욕타임스(NYT)가 황 CEO와 직속 부하인 킴벌리 파월 부사장의 혼외 관계 의혹을 보도하면서 시간외 거래에서 주가가 한때 8% 넘게 하락했다. 앞서 황 CEO가 다른 여성과의 관계를 인정했다는 내용도 보도됐다. 관련 인물의 중국 정보기관 연계 의혹까지 제기되면서 사안은 개인적 논란을 넘어 기업 지배구조와 경영 안정성 문제로 확대되는 양상이다. 엔비디아 이사회는 독립위원회를 구성해 조사에 착수하는 한편 황 CEO에 대한 신뢰를 유지한다고 밝혔다. 다만 추가 의혹과 경영진 교체 가능성을 둘러싼 보도가 이어지면서 투자자들의 경계심도 커지고 있다. 국민연금의 엔비디아 투자 위험은 직접 보유 주식에 국한되지 않는다. 국민연금은 엔비디아를 편입한 아이셰어즈 코어 S&P500 ETF, 인베스코 MSCI USA ETF, 티로프라이스 그로스 스톡 ETF 등도 보유하고 있다. 간접 투자분까지 고려하면 실제 엔비디아 관련 투자 노출 규모는 직접 보유분보다 클 수 있다. 다만 국민연금은 개별 종목과 펀드의 포지션을 실시간으로 공개하지 않아 6월 말 이후 실제 보유량은 달라졌을 가능성이 있다. 국민연금은 엔비디아의 핵심 부품 공급사인 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 주요 주주이기도 하다. 최근 공시 기준 국민연금의 삼성전자 지분율은 7.84%, SK하이닉스 지분율은 7.32%다. 11일 종가를 기준으로 산출한 보유 지분 평가액은 삼성전자 약 94조4794억원, SK하이닉스 약 68조2902억원이다. 여기에 엔비디아 평가액을 합산하면 세 기업에 대한 국민연금의 직접 투자 평가액은 약 174조5500억원에 달한다. 시장에서는 엔비디아의 경영 리스크가 국내 반도체 기업의 공급망에도 영향을 미칠지 주목하고 있다. 엔비디아는 AI 가속기 시장의 핵심 수요처이며 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 고대역폭메모리(HBM)를 공급하거나 공급 확대를 추진하는 주요 기업이다. 경영진 공백이나 미국의 수출 규제 강화, AI 반도체 사업 전략 변화가 현실화하면 국내 업체들의 HBM 공급 일정과 물량 협상에도 영향을 줄 가능성이 있다. 다만 CEO를 둘러싼 개인적 의혹만으로 엔비디아의 AI 반도체 수요나 기존 공급 계약이 즉각 바뀔 것으로 단정하기는 어렵다. 국내 반도체 업계에서도 이번 사안이 단기적인 HBM 주문 변화로 이어질 가능성은 제한적이라는 시각이 나온다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

items.t: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
items.d: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation In its first statement since the scandal broke, the company said it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.” Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia board meets to discuss CEO Jensen Huang’s future 02:16 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 5:41 AM EST / Updated Nov. 12, 2026, 8:32 AM EST By Mithil Aggarwal HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter. Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company. In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.” U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday. She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls. A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country.
